newsitem.title: CANADA: FIGURE SKATING-STOJKO LEADS AFTER SHORT PROGRAM.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-STOJKO LEADS AFTER SHORT PROGRAM.

text.p: Former two-time world champion Elvis Stojko of Canada led the men at Skate Canada International after the short programme Thursday.

Ilia Kulik of Russia was second and Michael Weiss of the United States was third in the short programme, which counts for one-third of the total score. The other two-thirds will be determined in Saturday's free skate.

In the pairs short programme, defending world champions Marina Eltsova and Andrei Bushkov of Russia were first, Americans Kyoko Ina and Jason Dungjen second, and Germans Mandy Woetzel and Ingo Steuer third.
Skate Canada is the second major international event of the figure skating season.
